name: jhind
biography: has shared a passion for security inside government, academia and industry for well over a decade. He has countless hours of sleep-deprived research and teaching in reverse engineering, cryptography, exploitation and general Internet deviancy. Completely frustrated with IDS in its current state, jhind's latest research attempts to advance the conversation of competent intrusion detection.
